title: SG RemoveOnRespec
html:
SG_RemoveOnRespec is a status group. Conditions in this status group are removed if the character they are on is respecced.

List of conditions in SG_RemoveOnRespec

Condition Effects
Absorbed Essence: Illasera
  •  Sarevok is permanently  Hastened and can't be  Paralysed,  Restrained, or have his movement speed reduced in any way.
Absorbed Essence: Sendai
  • Sarevok's  Armour Class is increased by 6.
Aid
  • Hit point maximum increased by 5⁠⁠Hit Points.
  • Hit point maximum increases by a further 5⁠⁠Hit Points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used.
Arcane Ward
  • Your Arcane Ward blocks damage equal to its charges and then loses 1 charge. Casting Abjuration spells will add charges equal to the level of the spell.
Armour of Agathys

Gained  5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell level⁠⁠Cold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

Aspect of the Elk
  • Movement Speed increased by +1.5 m (5 ft), as long as the affected entity stays near the barbarian.
Aspect of the Elk Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +1.5 m (5 ft) bonus to Movement Speed.
Aspect of the Stallion
  • Gained Barbarian Level * 2  temporary hit points.
Aspect of the Wolf
  • Affected entity has a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks, as long as it stays near the barbarian.
Aspect of the Wolf Aura
  • Affected entity and nearby allies have a +Dexterity Modifier bonus to Stealth Checks.
Aura of Conquest
  •  Frightened enemies within 3 m (10 ft) take 5⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn.
Aura of Courage
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Frightened.
Aura of Courage
  • Can't be  Frightened within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Devotion
  • The paladin and any nearby allies can't be  Charmed.
Aura of Devotion
  • Can't be  Charmed within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Hate
  • This creature and all fiends and undead within 3 m (10 ft) gain this creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their melee weapon damage.
Aura of Hate
  • Gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Murder
  • Nearby hostile creatures become Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Resistant or Immune to it.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Protection
  • The creature and its allies within 3 m (10 ft) gain the creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their saving throws.
Aura of Protection
  • Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Terror
  • Nearby enemies have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
  • Creatures that can't be  Frightened are immune to this aura.
Aura of Terror
  • Bane's oppressive aura gives the affected entity  Disadvantage on attack rolls and  Saving Throws while within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Warding
  • The paladin and any nearby allies have Resistance to damage from spells.
Aura of Warding
  • Resistant to damage from spells within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Avatar of Tyranny
  • Bane has come to Gortash's aid! Gortash has  150 temporary hit points,  Advantage on  Strength Checks and  Strength Saving Throws... And now has fearsome new powers!
  • Affected entity gains an extra 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks and Immunity to ⁠Thunder, ⁠Fire, and ⁠Force damage.
Barkskin
  •  Armour Class increased to 16.
Beacon of Hope
  • Has Advantage on Wisdom and Death  Saving Throws.
  • Regains the maximum possible Hit Points when healed.
Bear's Endurance
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution Checks.
  • Gain 7 Temporary Hit Points.
Bend Luck: Ability Check Bonus
  • Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.
Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty
  • Wild magic has twisted the affected entity's fate. It gained a -1d4 penalty to Ability Checks.
Bless
  • Gains a +1d4 bonus to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
Blessing of the Trickster

Has  Advantage on Stealth Checks.

Blink
  • At the end of each turn, there is a chance the affected entity gets  Blinked to the Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen or affected.
  • While in the  Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can only choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft). When combat ends, so does this effect.
Blinked to the Ethereal Plane
  • Affected entity is in the  Ethereal Plane, where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected.
  • While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft).
  • At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
Blurred
  • Attackers have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against this creature, unless they do not rely on sight or can see through illusions.
Bolstering Magic: Boon
  • Bolstered by wild magic. Has a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks
Brand of the Silverlight
  • This creature's weapon attacks deal an additional 5d8⁠⁠Radiant damage.
Bull's Strength
  • Has  Advantage on Strength Checks.
  • Weight Limit doubled.
Cat's Grace
  • Has  Advantage on Dexterity Checks.
  • Only takes half damage from falling.
Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.
  • Attacking, casting spells, or entering a brightly lit area ends this condition.
Continual Flame
  • Enveloped in flames that produce no heat and never seem to die out.
  • Identical to the  Light condition.
Countercharm
  • You have  Advantage on Saving Throws against being  Charmed or  Frightened.
Countercharm Aura
  • You and allies within 9 m (30 ft) have  Advantage on  Saving Throws against being Charmed and Frightened.
Crystal Skin
  • Affected entity has Resistance to all elemental damage.[See: Bugs]
Dark One's Blessing
  • Gained  temporary hit points equal to its Charisma modifier and Warlock level combined.
Darkvision
  • Can see in the dark out to the range of 12 m (40 ft).
Darkvision
  • Can see in the dark out to the range of 24 m (80 ft).
Defensive Flourish
  •  Armour Class increased by 4
Detect Thoughts
  • The affected creature can read the thoughts of certain creatures while talking to them.
Detecting Presence
  • Searching for Invisible creatures within 3 m (10 ft) that must make a  DEX Save (Spell save DC) or be  Revealed.
Disguise Self
  • Appearance is entirely changed.
Divine Favour
  • Your weapons deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Radiant damage.
Divine Guardian
  • Protected by a paladin's divine essence. Resistant to all damage.
Divine Sense
  • Has  Advantage on Attack Rolls against celestials, fiends, and undead.
Duergar Antidote
  • Has  Advantage on  Saving Throws against being Poisoned and Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Eagle's Splendour
  • Has  Advantage on Charisma Checks.
Elemental Affinity: Acid Resistance
  • You are Resistant to ⁠Acid damage.
Elemental Affinity: Cold Resistance
  • You are Resistant to ⁠Cold damage.
Elemental Affinity: Fire Resistance
  • You are Resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
Elemental Affinity: Lightning Resistance
  • You are Resistant to ⁠Lightning damage.
Elemental Affinity: Poison Resistance
  • You are Resistant to ⁠Poison damage.
Elemental Weapon: Acid
  • Has a +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Acid damage.
Elemental Weapon: Cold
  • Has a +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Cold damage.
Elemental Weapon: Fire
  • Has a +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage.
Elemental Weapon: Lightning
  • Has a +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Lightning damage.
Elemental Weapon: Thunder
  • Has a +1 bonus to  Attack Rolls and deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Thunder damage.
Elixir of Barkskin
  •  Armour Class increased to 16.
Elixir of Darkvision
  • Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).
Elixir of Guileful Movement
  • Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells, or magical effects.
  • Can't be  Paralysed or  Restrained.
  • Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Elixir of The Colossus
  • Size is increased
  • Weapons deal an additional 1d4 damage, and the affected entity has  Advantage on Strength checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Carrying capacity is also increased by 25%.
Endless Rage
  • Confers all the normal bonuses and resistances of the Rage variant of the Barbarian's chosen subclass, plus:
    • Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Physical damage with weapon attacks (damage type inherited from equipped weapon)
    • Suffer 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage per turn
  • Rage does not end until the Barbarian uses the End Rage Bonus Action or becomes incapacitated.
Enlarged
  • Size is increased.
  • Weapon attacks deal 1d4 more damage. Has  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
Entropic Ward
  • Missed an attack on a warlock. The warlock has  Advantage on their next  Attack Roll against the affected entity.
Evasive Footwork

Enemies have  Disadvantage on melee attacks against the affected entity.

Expeditious Retreat
  • Dash available as a Bonus Action.
False Life
  • Gain  7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.
Feather Fall
  • Rate of falling is slowed, granting Immunity to Falling damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Acid
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Cold
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Fire
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Force
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Force damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Lightning
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Necrotic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Necrotic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Piercing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Piercing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Poison
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Psychic
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Psychic damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Radiant
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Radiant damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Slashing
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Slashing damage.
Fiendish Resilience: Thunder
  • You have Resistance to ⁠Thunder damage.
Fire Shield: Chill
  • Wreathed in ice-cold flames.
  • Sheds light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Deals 2d8⁠⁠Cold damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.
Fire Shield: Warm
  • Wreathed in scorching flames.
  • Sheds light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
  • Has Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
  • Deals 2d8⁠⁠Fire damage to anyone who hits with a melee attack.
Flight
  • Fly up to target position, up to 18 m (60 ft) each turn using your Movement Speed.
Fox's Cunning
  • Has  Advantage on Intelligence Checks.
Freedom of Movement
  • The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by  Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects.
  • The affected creature cannot be  Paralyzed or  Restrained.
Frenzied
  • Deal an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Frenzied Spores
  • Glut has increased hit points and Strength. It has access to more spore spells.
Gaseous Form
  • Transformed into a cloud of mist.
  • Resistant to all non-magical damage.
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution, Dexterity, and Strength  Saving Throws.
  • Becomes Tiny in size.
  • Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak.
  • The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form.
  • Immune to  Bleeding.
